ao_bake.note: W4-B (engine gate memo §1 item 5): ORM.R = ambient occlusion baked per atlas part by headless Cycles (tools/tripo-pipeline/blender/bake_ao.py), distance 0.08 x figure height, the whole figure as occluder; gate orm_occlusion_baked_not_constant. ORM.R only acts on indirect/sky light (critic G03): without a SkyLight in the light profile it changes nothing in the frame (proposal, measured in the act)

orientation.method_note: per polygon: a ray along +normal and one along -normal (offset 1e-4 of height) against the whole candidate; area where only the +normal ray escapes counts outward, only the -normal ray escapes counts inward; score = (out - in) / (out + in)
